items.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. Very lived in and worked in.

ctx.x: Yes. Very lived in and worked in.
Memorabilia to the max and I often call this room the “Jazz Smithsonian of the Midwest.” I don’t know what’s going to happen to it when I die.
